questions.question: Which four areas is English VG1 assessed on?
options: Communication ability, language accuracy, content and reflection, and use of sources
questions.explanation: Assessment covers communication, language accuracy, content/reflection and the ability to use sources.

questions.question: What distinguishes higher grades from lower grades?
options: Vocabulary range, depth of reflection, grammatical accuracy and critical source use
The length of your answers alone
Using as many idioms as possible
questions.explanation: Grade differences lie in vocabulary range, depth of reflection, accuracy and critical use of sources.

questions.question: How many competence goals does the LK20 English curriculum specify for VG1?
questions.explanation: The LK20 curriculum has 17 competence goals covering communication, language, literature, sources and culture.

questions.question: What is the "standpunkt" grade?
options: The overall achievement grade based on the competence goals
The grade on a single test
questions.explanation: The standpunkt is the overall achievement grade; in addition, students may be drawn for a written or oral exam.

questions.question: Why is self-assessment important in exam preparation?
options: Honest evaluation of strengths and weaknesses is the first step toward effective preparation
It is required by law before each lesson
questions.explanation: Knowing your own strengths and weaknesses lets you target your preparation effectively.
